_comment: God Mode SCENE DEFINITION (201F4F51 template-free). The world-simulation console: a full-window frame — header (title · tick readout · run state · the processes chip), the transport + view-toggle row, the ten-field tab strip (style_bind picks primary/secondary/ghost per era), then the body: left readout/ledger/events column, the centre viewport pane holding the rtt globe + the generated legend card + the tile inspector, and the right column (life-supporting gauges REFILLED by the behaviour from habitability::BANDS · boundary water inputs · the twelve-lever rate rack). Three centre popups: the gate pause summary, the gate console (24 headroom rows), and the Starter. The `godmode` behaviour plays it (flicker-godmode); godmode.lua derives the style/colour paths from the RAW state words. Styles folded from the crate's quarantined scene_styles.json; chemistry.hab.* mirrors the pocepochs hab look (same observer, same read); the legend.* swatch block is GENERATED at enter from the paint functions — never authored here.
